lines.text: King Xerxes elevates Haman above all the princes, and the royal servants at the king's gate bow to him.
Mordecai will not bow to Haman despite day after day of warnings, and Haman is filled with rage.
Haman seeks to destroy all the Jews in the kingdom, and the lot falls on the seventh month.
Haman offers ten thousand talents of gold for a decree, and the king gives him his signet ring.
Couriers carry the edict out, and the king and Haman sit down to drink while Susa is confused.
